task_completion.description: Screaming Frog SEO Spider is launched and visible on the desktop.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Screaming Frog SEO Spider application window is open and active.

task_completion.description: Forms Based authentication is configured for the login URL with the specified credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Configuration > Authentication > Forms Based' dialog is shown with 'http://quotes.toscrape.com/login' (or https), username 'admin', and password 'password' entered.

task_completion.description: The crawl of the target URL is initiated and progress is visible.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The address bar contains 'http://quotes.toscrape.com/' (or https) and the progress bar/status indicates the crawl is running or finished.

task_completion.description: The 'Internal > HTML' data is exported to the specified CSV path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Export' dialog or a file explorer window shows a CSV file being saved to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/'.

task_completion.description: A text report is created at the specified path documenting the crawl results.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or file explorer shows 'auth_success_report.txt' in '~/Documents/SEO/reports/'. The content should mention the presence (or attempt to find) the '/logout/' URL.

integrity.description: The agent used the Screaming Frog GUI to perform the crawl and configuration rather than just CLI scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, menu selections, and dialog interactions within the Screaming Frog interface.

integrity.description: The crawl results in the GUI reflect the actual website content (quotes, authors).
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Internal' tab in Screaming Frog shows URLs from quotes.toscrape.com and not placeholder or unrelated data.

integrity.description: The CSV export was generated via the application export function, not manually typed into a text editor.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen clicking the 'Export' button in the Screaming Frog UI rather than just opening a blank file and typing CSV headers.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target site uses HTTPS; the agent may use https://quotes.toscrape.com even if the task says HTTP. Any username/password works for login. Crucially, the '/logout/' endpoint does not actually exist on this site (it returns a 404), so the agent's report should reflect its absence or the result of the crawl attempt for that specific fragment.
